name: Cloud Loom Weavers
description: Giant sky looms weaving clouds into colorful fabrics above a mountain village.
prompt: A single imaginative scene: enormous wooden looms floating in the sky above a mountain village, gentle cloud fibers being woven into long ribbons of sunset-colored fabric, tiny weavers on platforms, birds flying through threads, soft golden light, whimsical scale, highly detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Someone has to make the sunset’s fabric. ☁️🧵
